slides.headline: 6 AI TRICKS THAT FIND THE MONEY YOUR ACCOUNTANT MISSED
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei laughing with joy, waist-up in home kitchen, one fist tossing crumpled receipts into air, other hand raised triumphantly, plain background, documentary style, harsh flash, natural skin.

slides.headline: 1) TURN YOUR BANK STATEMENT INTO AN EXPENSE REPORT
slides.body: A restaurant owner pasted one month of card transactions into Claude. It sorted them into 14 categories, flagged 3 duplicate charges. His bookkeeper charges $150 a month for the same thing.

slides.headline: 2) FIND THE TAX DEDUCTIONS YOUR ACCOUNTANT MISSED
slides.body: A freelance designer uploaded a year of expenses. Claude flagged 6 missed deductions: home office, internet, phone, software, professional development, and parking. Her accountant charges $100 an hour for this review.
slides.image_prompt: Overhead close shot of six small stacks of paper receipts fanned across a white desk, a hand (cut at wrist) gripping a bold green marker mid-circle around one specific stack, the green circle thick and unmistakable, soft daylight from the side casting gentle shadows on the papers, no readable text on any receipt. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: forest green against white.

slides.headline: 3) BUILD A 90-DAY CASH FLOW FORECAST FROM SCRATCH
slides.body: A 6-person agency pasted their payment schedule into Claude. It flagged two months where they would go negative before it happened. An accountant had quoted $400 to build the same forecast.
slides.image_prompt: Close shot of graph paper on a white desk with a hand-drawn horizontal grid of small empty boxes stretching full width, two sections filled solid red each stamped with a bold downward ↓ arrow symbol, a hand (cut at wrist) gripping a red pencil hovering over a third section, warm desk lamp light from one side, no readable text anywhere in frame. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: signal red against white graph paper.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE YOUR PROFIT AND LOSS STATEMENT TONIGHT
slides.body: A solo founder typed revenue and 8 expense categories into Claude. It returned a formatted P&L with gross margin, operating expenses by line, and net profit. A CPA bills $300 for the same.

slides.headline: 5) GET A YEAR-END SUMMARY YOUR CPA WILL ACTUALLY USE
slides.body: A business owner spent 4 hours every January organizing numbers for her accountant. She pasted the same data into Claude. Her accountant called it the cleanest summary she had ever received.

slides.headline: 6) CATCH THE BILLING ERROR BEFORE YOU PAY IT
slides.body: A construction firm pasted 8 vendor invoices into Claude. It flagged a double-billed line on invoice 4 and a wrong rate on invoice 7, saving $1,800 before payments cleared.
slides.image_prompt: Close shot of a hand (cut at wrist) gripping a thick red marker hovering above a stack of paper invoices on a wooden desk, the top invoice face-up with one bold red circle around a single line item and a pen tip pointing directly at the circled area, warm desk lamp casting soft side shadows, no readable text on any page. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: signal red against warm wood.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body:
You will want these the next time a quarterly bill lands. Save this post and try one tonight.

caption:
Swipe through all 6 before you pay your next bookkeeping bill. These prompts do what accountants charge $200 an hour for. 💰

Six prompts in this post: turn a bank statement into a categorized expense report, find tax deductions your accountant missed, build a 90-day cash flow forecast, write a complete profit and loss statement, get a year-end summary your CPA will love, catch vendor billing errors before you approve payment.

Bookkeepers are the next professionals being quietly displaced. Not because AI replaces judgment, but because it handles the categorization and data entry that comes before judgment. That's what most small businesses are actually paying for. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
